issues.failure_explanation: The one-dimensional step, on which the higher-dimensional case is built fiber-by-fiber, asserts H^s(I) embeds into C^{0,s-1/2} for every s>1/2. For s>3/2 this is false (a Hölder exponent exceeding 1 forces constancy), and at s=3/2 H^{3/2} does not embed into Lipschitz functions, so the pointwise bound |v(x)| <= C x^{s-1/2}||v||_{H^s} is not established by the cited embedding; for half-integer s the stated L^2 bound is itself delicate (Lions–Magenes type failure of interpolation at half-integers). The lemma is invoked with s=p-1, i.e. s=2 for p=3 and larger s for higher p, exactly where the stated embedding is invalid.
